card.name: Event dates, times and ticket details
card.fires_on: Words in event listings that give when or how to attend, such as a weekday after "On view:", "p.m" in a time, "door" in "at the door", and "view" in "on view". Fires a little on a few unrelated words in web text.

modes.label: Dates and times
modes.description: Weekday names or time markers in event or exhibit announcements.

modes.label: Ticket and stay wording
modes.description: Words ending a short phrase about price or length, like "at the door" or "6 Nights".

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on the words in event notices that say when something happens or how to get in.
